review_candidates.description: Job Description As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer Lead at JPMorgan Chase within Corporate Structure - Infrastructure Platforms team, you will provide infrastructure solution design and delivery, ensuring platforms are secure, resilient, scalable, and compliant. Job Responsibilities Infrastructure Solution Design - Lead the design and architecture of infrastructure solutions across compute, storage, network, and virtualization platforms, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and business objectives. Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate analysis of complex infrastructure signals and documentation of mitigation options, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements. Project Delivery - Drive infrastructure initiatives from concept to production, including build, migration, upgrade, and decommission activities; and oversee project timelines, resource allocation, and stakeholder communication. Operational Excellence - Establish and enforce runbooks, monitoring and alerting standards, capacity planning, and operational readiness criteria while continuously improving incident prevention, detection, and response measures. Risk - Proactively identifying infrastructure risks such as resiliency gaps, single points of failure, capacity constraints, and security exposures, developing and executing risk mitigation plans, including architectural changes and remediation roadmaps. Requirements Translation - Translate business requirements into engineering requirements and technical designs, ensuring solutions align with technology strategy, roadmaps, and architectural guardrails and evaluate technology products and services, contribute to selection decisions, and guide implementation and integration to optimize platform capabilities. Security & Compliance - Ensure infrastructure designs incorporate security-by-design principles, including identity and access controls, encryption, segmentation, patching, vulnerability management, and auditability and support governance activities such as risk assessments, control reviews, technology lifecycle management, and change management. Automation & Modernization - Drive adoption of automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, and repeatable deployment patterns and lead infrastructure modernization initiatives such as data center migration and platform standardization. Collaboration & Communication - Foster strong partnerships with application teams, technology partners, and stakeholders and communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Leads reuse-first adoption of AI-assisted practices across delivery and automation routines to reduce recurring issues, ensuring changes are validated, traceable and auditable, and aligned to resiliency and security expectations. Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience Extensive experience in infrastructure engineering, with proven ownership of solution design and delivery in large-scale enterprise environments. Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity. Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations. Deep expertise in multiple domains, including Windows/Linux systems, virtualization and/or containers (e.g., ESXi, VMware), networking (DNS, routing, load balancing, firewalls), storage, and backup/recovery concepts. Demonstrated ability to lead technical design reviews, influence decision-making, and align diverse stakeholders. Strong experience in risk management, resiliency planning (HA/DR), and operational readiness. Proficiency with observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces), capacity forecasting, and performance engineering. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical documentation and present to leadership. Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, automation and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, PowerCLI) Familiarity with security and regulatory controls, vulnerability remediation processes, and audit support. Experience leading infrastructure modernization (e.g., data center migration, platform standardization). Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid cloud integration. review_candidates.title: Senior ICT Consultant
review_candidates.description: Joining Arup Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. The Opportunity We are looking for a Senior Information & Communications Technology (ICT) Consultant to join our Technology Consulting team, which is based within the Arup Digital Services Portfolio. It is a position suitable for someone who is already a consultant or has worked in a pre-sales technical design support or service provider/operator environment. We are looking for a passionate person with an in-depth knowledge and background in ICT facilities and cabling infrastructure design, cabling technologies and the cabling industry. We are looking for someone with strong social skills, who can work with, and supervise, other members of staff. As a technical specialist on projects, you will take a lead role in the delivery of projects and the interface with clients. The role will involve: Capturing, developing and interpreting client ICT infrastructure requirements. ICT infrastructure design development (from concept through to construction). Overseeing and supervising the tasks of more junior staff on projects. Checking others work in accordance with quality management systems. On-site monitoring and witness testing of ICT infrastructure installations. Contributing to scoping works and fee proposals for new ICT infrastructure projects. Developing more junior members in the team and enhancing the appreciation of ICT infrastructure standards across multi-disciplinary teams in Arup Projects will be in the UK and abroad. The candidate will be willing to travel when needed; however, this role does not require extended periods away. At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. Is this role right for you? We are looking for people who can demonstrate: Delivery of ICT infrastructure design projects across a range of sectors specifically Data Centres, Aviation, Roads & Tunnels and Commercial Property. In depth knowledge and track record of working in the following technology areas: Optical fibre cabling systems including FTTx and Passive Optical Networking (PON), copper structured cabling, outside plant systems, equipment rooms and pathways. Expertise in ICT cabling strategies, ICT space planning, ICT cabling system design, ICT cabling delivery and assurance. Expertise in system design and integration within the built environment, interfacing with manufacturers and validating system installation, commissioning, and testing in a construction advice role. An ability to write clear and concise reports and specifications in both technical and non-technical language, including preparation of easy-to-understand system diagrams and schematics. A working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit and Navisworks or similar, for the production and review of 3D design models. A good understanding and working knowledge of one of more of the following would be beneficial: Local/Wide Area Networking, Wireless LAN, Integrated Reception Systems, Radio Over IP, Private Mobile Radio and Cellular. Your technical skills and knowledge will be comprehensive and should allow you to comfortably advise our clients and develop design strategies with our internal teams. You will be capable of working on several projects at the same time and have the ability to prioritise activities for yourself and others. What we offer you At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs. Different People, Shared Values Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Marek Mazurowski (marek.mazurowski@arup.com) to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you. Our Application Process To understand what to expect next, please visit our https://www.arup.com/careers/arup-careers-uk-application-process. Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process. Recruitment Agencies - We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin. Overview Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. This role will sit in either our Runtime/Compute or the Developer Experience/CICD squad. As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will work across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and internal developer tooling. You will work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Infrastructure IT, and other platform teams to build, enhance, and support our developer platform. You will help define standards and best practices, and act as a force multiplier for engineering teams by improving reliability, scalability, and developer productivity. What You’ll Do Own and deliver medium-to-large platform projects from implementation through production Build and maintain internal platform services and tooling that improve developer experience and delivery velocity Partner with application teams to unblock delivery and align platform capabilities with developer needs Drive cloud cost efficiency and optimization across our cloud and infrastructure Improve operational excellence through observability, automation, and incident response Help evolve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-based workflows Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing Participate in on-call rotations and incident response What You Bring 5–7 years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering Proficiency with Python and Java. Familiarity with Kotlin, Go a plus Deep Kubernetes and container orchestration knowledge Proven CI/CD and GitOps experience Infrastructure as Code expertise (Terraform) Strong AWS and cloud-native experience Experience operating distributed, high-availability systems Strong ownership mindset and ability to deliver defined projects independently Clear communication and strong collaboration skills Nice to Have Experience with internal developer platforms or tooling Exposure to regulated or high-availability environments Backend development experience (Java, Python, Go, or similar) Familiarity with observability and reliability engineering practices Salary Range £96,000 – £120,000 (London) (Salary is determined by location and may vary based on geography) Why Platform Engineering at FBG Platform Engineering at FBG operates with a product-first mindset. review_candidates.title: Manager, Climate Investment Facility
review_candidates.description: Location: Republic of Korea, HQ City: Seoul Contract Type: Staff Grade: G10 Salary scale: International Scale End date of appointment 36 months Deadline: 25/09/2026 Job Reference: New-RP26-66 Please note that the deadline is based on Korean Standard Time Zone (KST, UTC+9) INTRODUCTION TO GGGI The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) is a treaty-based international, inter-governmental organization dedicated to supporting and promoting strong, inclusive and sustainable economic growth in developing countries and emerging economies. To learn more please visit about GGGI web page. The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) is developing, in partnership with the European Commission, a proposal for the Global Gateway Climate Investment Facility. The proposed four-year, EUR 10 million Facility would provide flexible, demand-driven technical assistance to EU partner countries to accelerate implementation of Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) by transforming climate commitments into investment-ready opportunities and financed implementation pathways. The proposed Facility would operate through an integrated Policy–Project–Finance model, supporting enabling policy and institutional frameworks, project preparation and investment structuring, and climate finance and investment mobilization. It is expected to support up to 15 partner countries and contribute to mobilizing at least EUR 1 billion in NDC- and Global Gateway-aligned investment, including at least EUR 750 million in private capital. This position is being prepared in anticipation of implementation of the proposed Facility. The proposal remains under development and no employment commitment arises from this Job Description. Recruitment and appointment to the position will be conditional on signature and entry into force of the Contribution Agreement between GGGI and the European Commission, confirmation of the approved project structure and budget, and completion of GGGI recruitment procedures. Position Summary The Manager will provide overall leadership, strategic direction, portfolio management and coordination for the proposed Facility. The Manager will lead development and implementation of a global pipeline of policy, project preparation and financing interventions; serve as the principal day-to-day interface with DG INTPA, EU Delegations, partner-country governments and the Facility Steering Committee; and ensure that approved interventions are delivered to high technical, fiduciary and results standards. The role will combine program leadership, investment origination, sustainable finance expertise, stakeholder management, resource allocation, quality assurance and donor reporting across a geographically and technically diverse portfolio. PURPOSE Lead the establishment and overall management of the Global Gateway Climate Investment Facility. Provide strategic leadership for a global, demand-driven portfolio of technical assistance interventions supporting NDC implementation, Global Gateway priorities, and the mobilization of public and private investment. Lead the identification, prioritization, design, and development of Facility interventions across the Policy–Project–Finance continuum, ensuring that support addresses material barriers to investment and implementation. Oversee the development of Project Information Notes (PINs) and maintain a high-quality pipeline of interventions and investment opportunities for consideration by the Facility Steering Committee. Drive the Facility’s contribution toward its proposed investment mobilization, project advancement, policy, institutional, and partnership targets, with particular attention to mobilizing private capital and creating opportunities for European participation. Ensure coherence across the Project Management Unit, Project Support Unit, Project Technical Unit, GGGI country and regional teams, global technical specialists, and external service providers involved in Facility delivery. Provide technical and managerial leadership on complex climate investment issues, including sustainable finance, project preparation, transaction structuring, adaptation finance, public investment management, blended finance, and carbon finance. ENGAGEMENT Serve as the principal GGGI counterpart for the European Commission on the Facility and maintain regular strategic and operational engagement with DG INTPA. Support the establishment and effective functioning of the Facility Steering Committee and present proposed interventions, portfolio updates, implementation progress, risks, and matters requiring strategic guidance or decision. Build and maintain strong working relationships with EU Delegations to identify country priorities, develop Facility pipelines, coordinate interventions, and ensure alignment with Global Gateway priorities and relevant EU initiatives. Engage senior government counterparts, including ministries of finance, planning authorities, sector ministries, regulators, national development banks, utilities, and other public institutions, to identify and advance high-impact opportunities for Facility support. Develop partnerships with European and international financial institutions, investors, companies, technology providers, engineering firms, advisory firms, development partners, and other relevant private-sector actors to advance investment opportunities and mobilize finance. Coordinate closely with GGGI regional and country teams, Sustainable Finance and other technical functions, and corporate support teams to mobilize expertise, maintain organizational alignment, and ensure effective implementation across the Facility portfolio. Represent the Facility in relevant external meetings, investment dialogues, technical forums, market-engagement activities, and other strategic platforms, communicating its objectives, pipeline, results, and opportunities for partnership. DELIVERY Leadpreparation and implementation of the Facility’s annual work plans, budgets, portfolio priorities, operational procedures, and resource-allocation decisions, subject to the governance arrangements established under the Contribution Agreement. Manage the end-to-end Facility pipeline, from country assessment and opportunity identification through technical scoping, PIN preparation, Steering Committee approval, implementation, monitoring, and completion. Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of approved interventions across policy and institutional reform, project preparation and investment structuring, climate finance, sustainable finance, carbon finance, and investment mobilization. Oversee allocation and deployment of Facility resources, including staff, consultants, framework agreements, technical service providers, and specialized expertise, ensuring value for money and compliance with GGGI and European Commission requirements. Establish and apply effective portfolio-management and quality-assurance processes to monitor implementation progress, budgets, risks, delivery milestones, technical quality, and achievement of expected results across multiple countries and interventions. Oversee monitoring, verification, and reporting of Facility results, including investment mobilization, project advancement, policy and institutional outcomes, stakeholder engagement, and other indicators established in the logical framework and Contribution Agreement. Ensure timely preparation of donor reports, Facility Steering Committee materials, management updates, and other required deliverables, while proactively identifying implementation risks, resolving delivery bottlenecks, and recommending corrective action. Requirements QUALIFICATIONS Master's degree in Economics, International Affairs, Public Policy, Environmental Management, or a related field. Preferably 10 years of professional experience in project management, sustainable finance, climate policy, carbon markets. At least 5 years of international work experience implementing and delivering projects in climate, green growth and/or sustainable finance, including substantive responsibility for project delivery across multiple countries or in collaboration with international partners and stakeholders. Demonstrated experience managing multiple multi-country, donor-funded projects, including budget, grant, and consultant management. Demonstrated experience designing new, complex programs of work, from origination to delivery. Fluency in both English is required; fluency in Franch and/or Spanish is a strong asset. Familiarity with GGGI mission, systems and processes is an advantage. FUNCTIONAL Strong project management and organizational skills to deliver complex, multi-country initiatives on time and within budget. Ability to translate technical and policy findings into clear guidance and knowledge products. Strong strategic foresight and ability to guide multiple programs of work towards mutually re-enforcing goals. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills at all levels; excellent ability to maintain positive relationships with strategic resource and implementation partners. Demonstrated ability to work effectively across diverse country contexts and manage collaboration across cultures, institutions, and time zones. Flexibility and resilience to adapt to changing priorities, evolving donor and stakeholder needs, and uncertainty in project environments. Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on quality, efficiency, and innovation. CORPORATE Demonstrates GGGI's values of Integrity, Excellence, and Sustainability. Promotes a culture of transparency, inclusiveness, and collaboration. Fosters mutual respect, trust, and partnership in multicultural environments. A broad understanding of end-to-end business processes and service delivery models is essential. Ensure service requirements, scope, ownership, controls, and operating models are clearly defined, scalable, and fit for purpose. Project Delivery: Lead projects related to the introduction, expansion, or enhancement of GSBS services. Manage planning, governance, risks, dependencies, timelines, and stakeholder engagement to ensure successful delivery and transition into operations. Global Standardisation: Drive consistency in service offerings, governance standards, and service management practices across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Operational Excellence - Establish and enforce runbooks, monitoring and alerting standards, capacity planning, and operational readiness criteria while continuously improving incident prevention, detection, and response measures. Whilst the role is largely undertaken during the normal working business day there is a requirement to cover late shifts and Saturday working to meet customer and business demands. About The Role This role provides technical service delivery to our customers through the use of Data Services technologies. By using market leading products and applying BTs process, quality and intellectual property, we provide our customers with services to facilitate their objectives through the power of communication. The role requires a skilled technical engineer who is an innovative, engaging, driven individual and has a proven record of achievement. Please note you must either hold or be eligible for SC (Security Clearance), BPSS & NPPV 3 Clearance for this role, which will require a minimum of 5 years working history in the UK to be eligible. What You’ll Be Doing Utilising experience and evolving technical ability to resolve technical delivery incidents, changes or problems relating to connectivity solutions for dedicated internet access and IP VPN. Progressing service delivery requests in line with agreed processes and procedures on both customer and provider edge routers and devices. Working effectively with the customer and/or their representatives, and other parts of BT during production, delivery & development. Providing remote support to onsite engineers during solution deployment and resolving issues. Actively supporting and implementing efficient ways of working and cost reduction. Essential Skills / Experience Hands-on experience delivering Data Services technologies, including LAN/WAN, Cisco and Cisco Meraki solutions, with proven ability to configure, commission and support Cisco routers and related network services. CCNA certified (or equivalent networking qualification) with practical experience across routing, switching, VLANs, WAN, LAN, Wi-Fi, BGP, HSRP, IP addressing, diagnostics, troubleshooting and PE/CE router configuration in a delivery environment. Proven ability to take ownership of technical deliveries, incidents and changes through to resolution, supported by strong organisational, prioritisation, communication and problem-solving skills while managing competing priorities and maintaining customer focus. Desirable Skills/experience CCNP certification, working towards CCNP, or progressing towards another equivalent advanced vendor networking certification. Experience supporting complex technical deliveries involving PE/CE router configuration, commissioning, troubleshooting or service-impacting change activity. Experience working across multiple stakeholders to resolve technical blockers, manage escalations and driving delivery issues through to completion. Our Package Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include: 10% on target annual bonus Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off Equalized maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us Holiday purchase scheme You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you’re ready. BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers. BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive. Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

new_matches.title: Senior ICT Consultant
new_matches.description: Joining Arup Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. The Opportunity We are looking for a Senior Information & Communications Technology (ICT) Consultant to join our Technology Consulting team, which is based within the Arup Digital Services Portfolio. It is a position suitable for someone who is already a consultant or has worked in a pre-sales technical design support or service provider/operator environment. We are looking for a passionate person with an in-depth knowledge and background in ICT facilities and cabling infrastructure design, cabling technologies and the cabling industry. We are looking for someone with strong social skills, who can work with, and supervise, other members of staff. As a technical specialist on projects, you will take a lead role in the delivery of projects and the interface with clients. The role will involve: Capturing, developing and interpreting client ICT infrastructure requirements. ICT infrastructure design development (from concept through to construction). Overseeing and supervising the tasks of more junior staff on projects. Checking others work in accordance with quality management systems. On-site monitoring and witness testing of ICT infrastructure installations. Contributing to scoping works and fee proposals for new ICT infrastructure projects. Developing more junior members in the team and enhancing the appreciation of ICT infrastructure standards across multi-disciplinary teams in Arup Projects will be in the UK and abroad. The candidate will be willing to travel when needed; however, this role does not require extended periods away. At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. Is this role right for you? We are looking for people who can demonstrate: Delivery of ICT infrastructure design projects across a range of sectors specifically Data Centres, Aviation, Roads & Tunnels and Commercial Property. In depth knowledge and track record of working in the following technology areas: Optical fibre cabling systems including FTTx and Passive Optical Networking (PON), copper structured cabling, outside plant systems, equipment rooms and pathways. Expertise in ICT cabling strategies, ICT space planning, ICT cabling system design, ICT cabling delivery and assurance. Expertise in system design and integration within the built environment, interfacing with manufacturers and validating system installation, commissioning, and testing in a construction advice role. An ability to write clear and concise reports and specifications in both technical and non-technical language, including preparation of easy-to-understand system diagrams and schematics. A working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit and Navisworks or similar, for the production and review of 3D design models. A good understanding and working knowledge of one of more of the following would be beneficial: Local/Wide Area Networking, Wireless LAN, Integrated Reception Systems, Radio Over IP, Private Mobile Radio and Cellular. Your technical skills and knowledge will be comprehensive and should allow you to comfortably advise our clients and develop design strategies with our internal teams. You will be capable of working on several projects at the same time and have the ability to prioritise activities for yourself and others. What we offer you At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs. Different People, Shared Values Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Marek Mazurowski (marek.mazurowski@arup.com) to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you. Our Application Process To understand what to expect next, please visit our https://www.arup.com/careers/arup-careers-uk-application-process. Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process. Recruitment Agencies - We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

new_matches.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Infrastructure - Core UK & IRE
new_matches.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. About The Team Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin. Overview Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. This role will sit in either our Runtime/Compute or the Developer Experience/CICD squad. As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will work across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and internal developer tooling. new_matches.title: Manager, Climate Investment Facility
new_matches.description: Location: Republic of Korea, HQ City: Seoul Contract Type: Staff Grade: G10 Salary scale: International Scale End date of appointment 36 months Deadline: 25/09/2026 Job Reference: New-RP26-66 Please note that the deadline is based on Korean Standard Time Zone (KST, UTC+9) INTRODUCTION TO GGGI The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) is a treaty-based international, inter-governmental organization dedicated to supporting and promoting strong, inclusive and sustainable economic growth in developing countries and emerging economies. To learn more please visit about GGGI web page. The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) is developing, in partnership with the European Commission, a proposal for the Global Gateway Climate Investment Facility. The proposed four-year, EUR 10 million Facility would provide flexible, demand-driven technical assistance to EU partner countries to accelerate implementation of Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) by transforming climate commitments into investment-ready opportunities and financed implementation pathways. The proposed Facility would operate through an integrated Policy–Project–Finance model, supporting enabling policy and institutional frameworks, project preparation and investment structuring, and climate finance and investment mobilization. It is expected to support up to 15 partner countries and contribute to mobilizing at least EUR 1 billion in NDC- and Global Gateway-aligned investment, including at least EUR 750 million in private capital. This position is being prepared in anticipation of implementation of the proposed Facility. The proposal remains under development and no employment commitment arises from this Job Description. Recruitment and appointment to the position will be conditional on signature and entry into force of the Contribution Agreement between GGGI and the European Commission, confirmation of the approved project structure and budget, and completion of GGGI recruitment procedures. Position Summary The Manager will provide overall leadership, strategic direction, portfolio management and coordination for the proposed Facility. The Manager will lead development and implementation of a global pipeline of policy, project preparation and financing interventions; serve as the principal day-to-day interface with DG INTPA, EU Delegations, partner-country governments and the Facility Steering Committee; and ensure that approved interventions are delivered to high technical, fiduciary and results standards. The role will combine program leadership, investment origination, sustainable finance expertise, stakeholder management, resource allocation, quality assurance and donor reporting across a geographically and technically diverse portfolio. PURPOSE Lead the establishment and overall management of the Global Gateway Climate Investment Facility. Provide strategic leadership for a global, demand-driven portfolio of technical assistance interventions supporting NDC implementation, Global Gateway priorities, and the mobilization of public and private investment. Lead the identification, prioritization, design, and development of Facility interventions across the Policy–Project–Finance continuum, ensuring that support addresses material barriers to investment and implementation. Oversee the development of Project Information Notes (PINs) and maintain a high-quality pipeline of interventions and investment opportunities for consideration by the Facility Steering Committee. Drive the Facility’s contribution toward its proposed investment mobilization, project advancement, policy, institutional, and partnership targets, with particular attention to mobilizing private capital and creating opportunities for European participation. Ensure coherence across the Project Management Unit, Project Support Unit, Project Technical Unit, GGGI country and regional teams, global technical specialists, and external service providers involved in Facility delivery. Provide technical and managerial leadership on complex climate investment issues, including sustainable finance, project preparation, transaction structuring, adaptation finance, public investment management, blended finance, and carbon finance. ENGAGEMENT Serve as the principal GGGI counterpart for the European Commission on the Facility and maintain regular strategic and operational engagement with DG INTPA. Support the establishment and effective functioning of the Facility Steering Committee and present proposed interventions, portfolio updates, implementation progress, risks, and matters requiring strategic guidance or decision. Build and maintain strong working relationships with EU Delegations to identify country priorities, develop Facility pipelines, coordinate interventions, and ensure alignment with Global Gateway priorities and relevant EU initiatives. Engage senior government counterparts, including ministries of finance, planning authorities, sector ministries, regulators, national development banks, utilities, and other public institutions, to identify and advance high-impact opportunities for Facility support. Develop partnerships with European and international financial institutions, investors, companies, technology providers, engineering firms, advisory firms, development partners, and other relevant private-sector actors to advance investment opportunities and mobilize finance. Coordinate closely with GGGI regional and country teams, Sustainable Finance and other technical functions, and corporate support teams to mobilize expertise, maintain organizational alignment, and ensure effective implementation across the Facility portfolio. Represent the Facility in relevant external meetings, investment dialogues, technical forums, market-engagement activities, and other strategic platforms, communicating its objectives, pipeline, results, and opportunities for partnership. DELIVERY Leadpreparation and implementation of the Facility’s annual work plans, budgets, portfolio priorities, operational procedures, and resource-allocation decisions, subject to the governance arrangements established under the Contribution Agreement. Manage the end-to-end Facility pipeline, from country assessment and opportunity identification through technical scoping, PIN preparation, Steering Committee approval, implementation, monitoring, and completion. Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of approved interventions across policy and institutional reform, project preparation and investment structuring, climate finance, sustainable finance, carbon finance, and investment mobilization. Oversee allocation and deployment of Facility resources, including staff, consultants, framework agreements, technical service providers, and specialized expertise, ensuring value for money and compliance with GGGI and European Commission requirements. Establish and apply effective portfolio-management and quality-assurance processes to monitor implementation progress, budgets, risks, delivery milestones, technical quality, and achievement of expected results across multiple countries and interventions. Oversee monitoring, verification, and reporting of Facility results, including investment mobilization, project advancement, policy and institutional outcomes, stakeholder engagement, and other indicators established in the logical framework and Contribution Agreement. Ensure timely preparation of donor reports, Facility Steering Committee materials, management updates, and other required deliverables, while proactively identifying implementation risks, resolving delivery bottlenecks, and recommending corrective action. Requirements QUALIFICATIONS Master's degree in Economics, International Affairs, Public Policy, Environmental Management, or a related field. Preferably 10 years of professional experience in project management, sustainable finance, climate policy, carbon markets. At least 5 years of international work experience implementing and delivering projects in climate, green growth and/or sustainable finance, including substantive responsibility for project delivery across multiple countries or in collaboration with international partners and stakeholders. Demonstrated experience managing multiple multi-country, donor-funded projects, including budget, grant, and consultant management. Demonstrated experience designing new, complex programs of work, from origination to delivery. Fluency in both English is required; fluency in Franch and/or Spanish is a strong asset. Familiarity with GGGI mission, systems and processes is an advantage. FUNCTIONAL Strong project management and organizational skills to deliver complex, multi-country initiatives on time and within budget. Ability to translate technical and policy findings into clear guidance and knowledge products. Strong strategic foresight and ability to guide multiple programs of work towards mutually re-enforcing goals. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills at all levels; excellent ability to maintain positive relationships with strategic resource and implementation partners. Demonstrated ability to work effectively across diverse country contexts and manage collaboration across cultures, institutions, and time zones. Flexibility and resilience to adapt to changing priorities, evolving donor and stakeholder needs, and uncertainty in project environments. Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on quality, efficiency, and innovation. CORPORATE Demonstrates GGGI's values of Integrity, Excellence, and Sustainability. Promotes a culture of transparency, inclusiveness, and collaboration. Fosters mutual respect, trust, and partnership in multicultural environments. Child protection – GGGI is committed to child protection, irrespective of whether any specific area of work involves direct contact with children. GGGI’s Child Protection Policy is written in accordance with the Convention on the Rights of the Child.

We combine a technically led and digitally enabled approach with an exceptional team of experts; ultimately, it’s our people that make the difference. Our purpose, making amazing happen for a better world, reflects our focus on delivering results for people, planet and profit. About The Role Role Purpose The GSBS Service Management Lead plays a key role in supporting the effective project management governance, performance, and continuous improvement of Global Shared Business Services (GSBS). Operating within the GSBS Performance and Governance team, the role helps ensure that services are delivered consistently, efficiently, and in alignment with business requirements and organisational objectives. The role is responsible for driving service management practices across GSBS, supporting the onboarding of new services, monitoring service performance, and partnering with operational teams to identify and implement opportunities for improvement. Working across multiple functions, regions, and service lines, the role provides structure, visibility, and coordination to support the delivery of high-quality services and a positive customer experience. Acting as a key link between business stakeholders, service owners, process owners, and operational teams, the role supports service governance, performance management, service reviews, and continuous improvement activities. The position also contributes to the development and maintenance of service management frameworks, standards, reporting, and key performance indicators across GSBS. In addition to service management responsibilities, the role will lead or support initiatives that enhance service performance, strengthen governance, improve customer experience, or support the implementation of new services and capabilities across GSBS. The role requires a strong understanding of Shared Services and Global Business Services (GBS) environments, together with experience in service management, service transitions, operational improvement, and stakeholder engagement. A broad understanding of end-to-end business processes and service delivery models is essential. The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of autonomy, providing service management expertise, guidance, and challenge to stakeholders across a global matrix organisation. Success in the role requires strong collaboration, customer focus, analytical thinking, and a pragmatic approach to improving service performance and business outcomes. Responsibilities Service Governance & Portfolio Management: Support the governance and ongoing development of the GSBS service portfolio, ensuring services are clearly defined, aligned to the GSBS operating model, and consistently managed across regions. Service Design & Expansion: Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, and operational teams to evaluate, design, and onboard new services into GSBS. Ensure service requirements, scope, ownership, controls, and operating models are clearly defined, scalable, and fit for purpose. Project Delivery: Lead projects related to the introduction, expansion, or enhancement of GSBS services. Manage planning, governance, risks, dependencies, timelines, and stakeholder engagement to ensure successful delivery and transition into operations. Global Standardisation: Drive consistency in service offerings, governance standards, and service management practices across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Identify opportunities to standardise services and processes while balancing regional business requirements. With a heritage of almost 200 years, we are known for our excellence, and our authentic and enduring relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. Clients seek out MinterEllison to help them solve complex problems every day. We do this by our full-service legal offering and complementary consulting offering. We offer opportunities to work on industry-leading mandates for top-tier clients, while being part of a high-performing and collaborative team that values excellence, diversity of thought, curiosity, and inclusion. We value our people and empower them to achieve their ambitions - with the support, trust and autonomy to grow their careers in meaningful ways. At MinterEllison, we're leading the way with AI and other emerging technologies, powering innovation right across our firm. You will have the opportunity to engage with AI tools we've built, and other external AI tools, to enhance efficiencies and excellence internally and with our clients. We support sustainable ways of working regarding how, when and where you work and offer a wide range of social, financial and health benefits (see https://www.minterellison.com/-/media/Minter-Ellison/Files/Careers/MinterEllison-Employee-Benefits-Dec_2025.pdf ) The Team Our Digital team at MinterEllison delivers technology solutions that keep the firm running at its best. The IT Services team in Sydney is a tight-knit group focused on providing seamless, high-quality technology support to our people and clients. We pride ourselves on a collaborative culture, a commitment to continuous improvement, and ensuring every user experience is exceptional - from the boardroom to the desktop. Your Role We are seeking a Desktop Support Analyst to join our IT Services team in Sydney. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technology professional who enjoys solving problems and supporting people. Working as part of a rotating shift roster (currently 7:30am–6:00pm weekdays), you will provide proactive second-level desktop support and play a key role in ensuring our technology environments run smoothly. You will also participate in a national on-call roster for after-hours support. Key responsibilities include: Providing frontline technical support face-to-face, over the phone, and via ServiceNow - managing incidents and requests from start to finish Taking ownership of support tickets and delivering timely resolutions in line with service levels Managing end-user technology assets including device allocation, tracking, and lifecycle management Delivering Audio Visual (AV) support - setting up and testing equipment for meetings and events, with a focus on client floor requirements Providing real-time support during client meetings and events to ensure a seamless experience Collaborating with infrastructure and broader IT teams on AV solutions and service improvements More About You We are looking for a customer-focused IT professional who brings: Experience supporting a Windows desktop environment (PCs, laptops, printers, mobile devices, remote access, and peripherals) Knowledge of VoIP, mobile, and internet technologies Familiarity with network and server systems, including switches, routers, and patch panels Understanding of ITIL principles and Change Management processes Strong communication skills - you can explain technical concepts in plain language A proactive, self-starting approach with sound problem-solving ability The ability to work calmly under pressure and manage competing priorities A genuine desire to help people and deliver excellent service How To Apply We encourage applications from people of all ages, abilities, cultural backgrounds, genders (including trans or gender diverse), LGBTQ+ people and those with carer responsibilities. We particularly encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people to apply. We prefer to connect with people directly, so please submit your CV by clicking on the 'Apply' button. We encourage all applications, including if you do not meet all the criteria listed for the role. Your application will also enable us to consider you for other opportunities that may be available at MinterEllison. If you are currently a MinterEllison employee, please apply through the internal careers page. If you would like further information, require any adjustments throughout the recruitment process or for a confidential discussion, Jess.Brown@minterellison.com.
